digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate CI – macOS pytest cell
propositions: macOS pytest cell is the critical-path long pole (~2140-2486s) causing 43min gate runtime; identical test suite runs 3.7x slower on macOS vs Ubuntu due to per-test overhead, not CPU-bound differences
reduce macOS default suite from full breadth to platform_compat subset (file locking, atomic ops, subprocess timeout, git contention) while keeping integration tier and leaving Ubuntu unchanged
auto-apply platform_compat marker centrally in tests/conftest.py via _PLATFORM_COMPAT_PATH_FRAGMENTS tuple rather than per-file markers to prevent silent drift
macOS DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS branch changes from two-branch ternary to three-branch expression selecting 'platform_compat and not external'
parity guard test verifies macOS subset still collects platform-sensitive files and Ubuntu suite selection remains unchanged (not integration and not external and not repo_policy)
